summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, announcing its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports total revenues of RMB7.90 billion ($1.15 billion), a 7.3% year-over-year increase, and IFRS net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB2.09 billion ($303 million), compared to RMB4.29 billion in the same period of 2025, primarily due to a gain on deemed disposal of an associate in the prior year. The filing contains no terms regarding an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation—it is a routine earnings release for the foreign private issuer.
